digest.component_or_area: stamped file locking across enrich_drain, compact_trigger, gc_trigger
propositions: Lock acquisition logic (O_EXCL create, stamp write, stale reclaim with single retry) is duplicated identically across three worker modules: enrich_drain, compact_trigger, and gc_trigger

Release semantics differ: enrich_drain's single try-block skips unlink on close failure (leaking lock until ceiling), while compact_trigger and gc_trigger use two independent try-blocks ensuring unlink always runs

Extract shared stamped_lock helper module with stamped_file_lock() and release_stamped_lock() functions, fixing the drain's release semantics to the two-block form and preserving the drain's holder-naming WARNING
The drain's reclaim WARNING describing lock holder must survive via describe_holder callback; stamp must omit trailing newline; stamp-failure WARNING must apply to all three workers
Six lock functions must remain as module-level attributes of their original modules with unchanged signatures to satisfy existing monkeypatch-by-name test constraints
